description:
Ultra-light taskbar that follows the GNOME Shell way.

Minimal fork of Tasks in panel: just the tasks, no settings, fewer than 200 lines of code.

 Tasks of the active workspace only.
 Unfocused tasks are dimmed.
 Tasks demanding attention are highlighted.
 Right-click to show the app menu.
 Middle-click to open a new app window.
 Display Chromium web apps' real icons.

For more options, install Tasks in panel instead.
name: Tasks
